context: Two managers debrief after a planning meeting
purpose: Teach: 全文/方策/単一/抜本/内外/明示/明白/さらなる

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: お疲れ様。さっきの会議、議事録の全文に目を通したけど、論点が多すぎたね。
lines.en: Good work. I read the full minutes from the meeting, but there were too many issues.
lines.style: Tired but composed senior manager, measured exhale tone

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本当に。来期の方策については、まだ部内でも意見が割れていますし。
lines.en: Really. Even within the department, opinions are still divided on next term's strategy.
lines.style: Crisp professional female voice, slight concern underneath

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 部長は単一の指標で評価したいみたいだけど、現場としては無理があるよ。
lines.en: The director seems to want to evaluate with a single metric, but on the ground it's unrealistic.
lines.style: Frustrated lowered voice, leaning in confidentially

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、抜本的な見直しが必要だと思います。小手先の調整では追いつきません。
lines.en: Yes, I think we need a fundamental review. Surface-level adjustments won't keep up.
lines.style: Firm assertive tone, conviction in her words

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 内外の競合状況を考えると、確かに今のままじゃまずいな。
lines.en: Considering the competitive situation at home and abroad, the current state really won't do.
lines.style: Reflective concerned tone, weighing the stakes

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 次の会議では、優先順位を明示してもらわないと議論が進みませんよ。
lines.en: Unless they clearly specify the priorities in the next meeting, the discussion won't move forward.
lines.style: Slightly exasperated but professional, businesslike clip tone

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 同感だ。予算が足りないのは明白な事実なんだから、まず数字を出すべきだよ。
lines.en: I agree. It's an obvious fact that the budget is insufficient, so they should put numbers out first.
lines.style: Decisive nodding tone, hand-on-table conviction, distinct timbre that anchors the scene

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: では私の方で、さらなる資料を準備して明日の朝までに共有しておきます。
lines.en: Then I'll prepare additional materials on my end and share them by tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Calm reliable closer, taking ownership warmly
